description: 道の駅データ [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in National Land Numerical Information (国土数値情報) download site of MLIT, Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 国土交通省. 本データは、道路利用者のための「休憩機能」、道路利用者や地域住民のための「情報発信機能」、町と町が手を結び活力ある地域づくりを共に行うための「地域の連携機能」の3つの機能を併せ持つ休憩施設として設置されている「道の駅」位置を整備したものです。. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 国土交通省. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp, geojson. The portal shows 2019-12-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is non-commercial use only under the download site terms. Caveats: this record was written from the product page on the download site (title, description where given, licence, formats and dates), so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-japan-mlit-national-land-numerical-information.
